quotes.name: Aaliyah Brennan
quotes.quote: To be honest, I'm not sure what my performance means for my standing in the city - I've just been trying to keep up with my work at the mobile clinic and enjoy the little moments, like the A's winning streak. It's been a while since I've felt like I'm really making a difference, but I'm just taking things one day at a time.
